entries.title: Machine learning helps track semiconductor defects under more realistic temperature conditions
entries.summary: All materials contain inherent defects. These are not always harmful, since they can be used to engineer and introduce certain properties into a material. However, it is crucial to understand how they function and how they affect the material's properties.
